description: util.rs split_headers_body() scans bytes with a manual loop testing starts_with at each byte position. For large articles the inner loop runs len(article) times. The existing codebase already uses memchr::memmem::Finder (in mime_parser.rs). Using Finder::new(b"\r\n\r\n").find() would reduce the search to a SIMD-accelerated single pass.
title: core: split_headers_body uses O(n) byte-by-byte loop; memchr would be faster
